newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson considers China plant - report.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson considers China plant - report.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson is considering setting up a plant in China for the manufacturing of microwave links, daily newspaper the Gothenburg Post said on Thursday.
"We could have our own manufacturing in China," Henrik Brehmer, spokesman of the Ericsson Microwave Systems unit, was quoted by the newspaper as saying.
The unit has had a person stationed in southern China for six months and another person will go there shortly to help with marketing, the daily said.
"Ericsson's single largest customer, a telephone operator, operates in southern China," Brehmer told the newspaper.
"We naturally hope that we can come along and sell our microwave links."
The new generation of microwave links, Mini-Link, is one of the group's best sellers, the Gothenburg Post said.
The links are attached to roofs, masts or walls and help transmitting computer communication and speech.
